content: BUD-15 PR 104 defines chk-v1 CHK encryption: chk_key equals SHA256(plaintext), HKDF-SHA256 derives AES-256-GCM key, fixed zero nonce is safe only when keys are content-derived per plaintext or per chunk, and both ciphertext hash and plaintext hash checks are security-critical. It removes hashtree sz semantics and keeps servers as ciphertext-only normal Blossom storage.
